title: Core geometric product Picard openness with an auxiliary trivial module
statement: Under the hypotheses of lem-sc-picard-product-open, there exist an open neighbourhood U of s and an auxiliary module N on the base change of X times_S Y to U such that L restricted to that open is isomorphic to N and N is isomorphic to the unit module.

proof.text: Construct the multiple Picard triviality locus using the degree-one Kunneth injectivity lemma, universal structure-sheaf pushforward, flat base change in degree zero, and the proper closed-image argument; the resulting local Picard representative is then identified with the unit module after shrinking.

mathlib_searches.query: Picard product openness with an auxiliary invertible module on an open base change

lean.statement:
theorem picard_product_open_core
    {S X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ S) (g : Y ⟶ S)
    [Flat f] [IsProper f] [LocallyOfFinitePresentation f]
    [Flat g] [IsProper g] [LocallyOfFinitePresentation g]
    (σ : S ⟶ X) (τ : S ⟶ Y)
    (hσ : σ ≫ f = 𝟙 S) (hτ : τ ≫ g = 𝟙 S)
    (s : S) (L : (pullback f g).Modules) [L.IsInvertible]
    (hO : ∀ {T : Scheme.{u}} (t : T ⟶ S),
      IsIso ((Classical.choose
        (Scheme.Modules.exists_tensorPullbackAdjunction (pullback.snd f t))).unit.app
          (SheafOfModules.unit T.ringCatSheaf)))
    (hO' : ∀ {T : Scheme.{u}} (t : T ⟶ S),
      IsIso ((Classical.choose
        (Scheme.Modules.exists_tensorPullbackAdjunction (pullback.snd g t))).unit.app
          (SheafOfModules.unit T.ringCatSheaf)))
    (h₁ : Nonempty ((Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback
      (pullback.lift (𝟙 X) (f ≫ τ) (by simp [hτ]))).obj L ≅
        SheafOfModules.unit X.ringCatSheaf))
    (h₂ : Nonempty ((Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback
      (pullback.lift (g ≫ σ) (𝟙 Y) (by simp [hσ]))).obj L ≅
        SheafOfModules.unit Y.ringCatSheaf))
    (hs : Nonempty ((Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback
      ((pullback.fst f g ≫ f).fiberι s)).obj L ≅ SheafOfModules.unit _)) :
    ∃ U : S.Opens, s ∈ U ∧ ∃ N : (pullback (pullback.fst f g ≫ f) U.ι).Modules,
      Nonempty ((Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback
        (pullback.fst (pullback.fst f g ≫ f) U.ι)).obj L ≅
          N) ∧
      Nonempty (N ≅ SheafOfModules.unit
        (pullback (pullback.fst f g ≫ f) U.ι).ringCatSheaf)
